question: If $A$ and $B$ are symmetric matrices of the same order, show that $AB-BA$ is skew-symmetric.
explanation:
Symmetry of the given matrices
Since $A$ and $B$ are symmetric, $$A^T=A,\quad B^T=B$$
Transpose of the difference
Using $(AB)^T=B^TA^T$, $$\left(AB-BA\right)^T=(AB)^T-(BA)^T=B^TA^T-A^TB^T$$
Substitution of symmetry conditions
$$\left(AB-BA\right)^T=BA-AB=-(AB-BA)$$
Hence, $AB-BA$ is skew-symmetric.
